63163-studies-in-the-wagnerian-drama.creator: Henry Edward Krehbiel
63163-studies-in-the-wagnerian-drama.description: A book by Henry Edward Krehbiel. tra.--How Wagner Touches Hands with his Predecessors.--Poet and Composer.--Music a Means, not an Aim in the Drama.--A Typical Teuton, but also a Cosmopolite.--Teutonic and Roman Ideals.--Absolute Beauty and Characteristic Beauty.--The Ethical Idea in Wagner's Dramas.--Fundamental Principle of his Constructive Scheme. The Typical Phrases.--Symbols, not Labels.--Music as a Language.--Characteristics of Some Typical Phrases.

arxiv-2103-05821.title: Mapping the phase diagram of the quantum anomalous Hall and topological Hall effects in a dual-gated magnetic topological insulator heterostructure
arxiv-2103-05821.creator: Run Xiao †, Di Xiao †, Jue Jiang †, Jae-Ho Shin, Fei Wang, Yi-Fan Zhao, Ruo-Xi Zhang, Anthony Richardella, Ke Wang, Morteza Kayyalha, Moses H. W. Chan, Chao-Xing Liu, Cui-Zu Chang, Nitin Samarth
arxiv-2103-05821.description: Abstract We use magnetotransport in dual-gated magnetic topological insulator heterostructures to map out a phase diagram of the topological Hall and quantum anomalous Hall effects as a function of the chemical potential (primarily determined by the back gate voltage) and the asymmetric potential (primarily determined by the top gate voltage).

arxiv-2105-15004.title: Generalization Error Rates in Kernel Regression: The Crossover from the Noiseless to Noisy Regime
arxiv-2105-15004.creator: Hugo Cui, Bruno Loureiro, Florent Krzakala, Lenka Zdeborová
arxiv-2105-15004.description: Abstract In this manuscript we consider Kernel Ridge Regression (KRR) under the Gaussian design. Exponents for the decay of the excess generalization error of KRR have been reported in various works under the assumption of power-law decay of eigenvalues of the features co-variance.

arxiv-2106-01752.description: Abstract Context. The full third Gaia data release will provide, for the first time, the calibrated spectra obtained with the blue and red Gaia slitless spectrophotometers (BP and RP, respectively). Gaia is a very complex mission and cannot be considered as a single instrument, but rather as many instruments.

arxiv-2402-06213.title: Multi-source-free Domain Adaptation via Uncertainty-aware Adaptive Distillation
arxiv-2402-06213.creator: Yaxuan Song, Jianan Fan, Dongnan Liu, Weidong Cai
arxiv-2402-06213.description: Abstract Source-free domain adaptation (SFDA) alleviates the domain discrepancy among data obtained from domains without accessing the data for the awareness of data privacy. However, existing conventional SFDA methods face inherent limitations in medical contexts, where medical data are typically collected from multiple institutions using various equipment.

arxiv-2402-15921.title: Masked Pretraining Strategy for Neural Potentials
arxiv-2402-15921.creator: Zehua Zhang, Zijie Li, Amir Barati Farimani
arxiv-2402-15921.description: Abstract We propose a masked pretraining method for Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) to improve their performance on fitting potential energy surfaces, particularly in water and small organic molecule systems. GNNs are pretrained by recovering spatial information of masked-out atoms from molecules selected with certain ratios, then transferred and finetuned on atomic forcefields.

arxiv-2409-01372.title: Vacuum polarisation effects in impulsive fields
arxiv-2409-01372.creator: Anton Ilderton, Hannah Kingham
arxiv-2409-01372.description: Abstract Photons impinging on strong electromagnetic fields can change both momentum and helicity state, due to quantum vacuum polarisation. We investigate these effects in the collision of photons with impulsive PP-waves, which describe e.g. the fields of ultra-boosted charge distributions. We connect our results to vacuum birefringence and quantum reflection in both QED and SUSY QED.

arxiv-2501-18591.title: Non-Hermitian catalysis of spontaneous symmetry breaking on Euclidean and hyperbolic lattices
arxiv-2501-18591.creator: Christopher A. Leong, Bitan Roy
arxiv-2501-18591.description: Abstract Depending on the lattice geometry, the prototypical nearest-neighbor (NN) tight-binding model for free fermions gives rise to particle-hole symmetric emergent Dirac liquids, Fermi liquids, and (quasi)-flat bands near half filling or zero energy on (bipartite) Euclidean and hyperbolic lattices, respectively, embedded on flat and negatively curved spaces.

arxiv-2503-14694.title: HaploVL: A Single-Transformer Baseline for Multi-Modal Understanding
arxiv-2503-14694.creator: Rui Yang, Lin Song, Yicheng Xiao, Runhui Huang, Yixiao Ge, Ying Shan, Hengshuang Zhao
arxiv-2503-14694.description: Abstract Recent advancements in large language models (LLMs) have significantly propelled the development of large multi-modal models (LMMs), highlighting the potential for general and intelligent assistants. However, most LMMs model visual and textual modalities separately, leading to recent efforts to develop native LMMs using a single transformer.

arxiv-2509-16621.title: The Role of Vocabularies in Learning Sparse Representations for Ranking
arxiv-2509-16621.creator:
ame Hiun Kim \email hiun.kim@navercorp.com, 
ame Tae Kwan Lee \email taekwan.lee@navercorp.com, 
ame Taeryun Won \email lory.tail@navercorp.com
arxiv-2509-16621.description: Abstract Learned Sparse Retrieval (LSR) such as SPLADE has growing interest for effective semantic 1st stage matching while enjoying the efficiency of inverted indices. A recent work on learning SPLADE models with expanded vocabularies (ESPLADE) was proposed to represent queries and documents into a sparse space of custom vocabulary which have different levels of vocabularic granularity.

arxiv-2601-02887.title: Study of C ​ P CP violation in Λ b 0 → N ∗ ​ M \Lambda_{b}^{0}\rightarrow N^{*}M decays with the final-state rescattering mechanism
arxiv-2601-02887.creator: Hui-Qiang Shang a , Tian-Liang Feng b , Jing Gao c , Qin Qin a and Fu-Sheng Yu b
arxiv-2601-02887.description: Abstract In this work, we investigate the charmless non-leptonic two-body Λ b \Lambda_{b} decays within the framework of final-state rescattering mechanism. In contrast to the Cutkosky cutting method, we compute both the absorptive and dispersive parts of the hadronic rescattering triangle diagrams.

britannica-1911-ficino-marsilio.description: Article 'Ficino, Marsilio' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 10), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. writer, was born at Figline, in the upper Arno valley, in the year 1433. His father, a physician of some eminence, settled in Florence, and attached himself to the person of Cosimo de’ Medici. pmc-10595843.title: Health & healthcare needs among refugees from Ukraine arriving in Norway during 2022
pmc-10595843.creator: T M Hansen, T S Skogheim, Y Helland
pmc-10595843.description: The full-scale invasion of Ukraine has led to a surge in refugees coming to Norway. Systematic information about the health and healthcare needs of the group, which may differ significantly from that of other refugees, is lacking. This study aimed to measure self-reported health and healthcare needs in a sample of adult refugees from Ukraine.

pmc-10669690.creator: Jonatan Alpirez, Lilia Carolina Leon-Moreno, Irene Guadalupe Aguilar-García, Rolando Castañeda-Arellano, Judith Marcela Dueñas-Jiménez, Cesar Rodolfo Asencio-Piña, Sergio Horacio Dueñas-Jiménez
pmc-10669690.description: Traumatic brain injury has been the leading cause of mortality and morbidity in human beings. One of the most susceptible structures to this damage is the hippocampus due to cellular and synaptic loss and impaired hippocampal connectivity to the brain, brain stem, and spinal cord.

pmc-13076691.title: Bacterial protein-oleate complexes induce ferroptosis-like cell death in colorectal cancer cells by disrupting cell membranes and inhibiting the β-catenin-GPX4 axis
pmc-13076691.creator: Naeem Ullah, Abdelbasset Yabrag, Amjad Ali, Aftab Nadeem
pmc-13076691.description: The tumoricidal activity of human α-lactalbumin complexes, such as HAMLET and its α-helical domain with sodium oleate, is well-documented. However, the potential of bacterial α-helical proteins to form analogous anticancer complexes remains unexplored. In the current study, we demonstrate that α-helical proteins of bacterial origin can form tumoricidal complexes with sodium oleate.

pmc-13385494.title: Accumulation of embryos to improve outcomes in advanced-age women undergoing IVF/ICSI cycles: a retrospective cohort study
pmc-13385494.creator: Mingya Cao, Yue Wang, Liang Zhou, Kexin Xing, Huanjun Li, Yuanyuan Liu, Qingyun Sun, Xuli Zhu, Zhiming Zhao
pmc-13385494.description: ObjectiveTo investigate the effect of the embryo accumulation strategy prior to embryo transfer on reproductive outcomes among advanced-age women undergoing IVF/ICSI treatment.MethodsThis retrospective study included 970 advanced-age female patients undergoing in vitro fertilization/intracytoplasmic sperm injection (IVF/ICSI) treatment at the Second Hospital of Hebei Medical University from 2012 to 2022.

pmc-13531248.title: Gabapentinoid Poisoning Presentations to Victorian Emergency Departments: A 15‐Year Trend Analysis
pmc-13531248.creator: Bishaal Tej Gurung, Amy McNeilage, Angus Skeen, Tina Lam, Joanna F Dipnall, Jane Hayman, Suzanne Nielsen, Ting Xia
pmc-13531248.description: This study identified and characterised 1207 emergency department presentations related to gabapentinoid overdose in Victoria from 2009–2010 to 2023–2024. Presentation rates increased substantially since 2009–2010, and about half (49.5%; 597/1207) of all presentations were classified as intentional. Co‐ingestants were common, although 36.2% (437/1207) of presentations were reported to involve gabapentinoids alone.

pmc-13583762.title: Disability inclusion as a missing pillar of Africa’s non-communicable disease response
pmc-13583762.creator: Abdul-Aziz Seidu, Augustus Osborne, Pascal Agbadi, John Kuumuori Ganle, Leonard Baatiema, Agustina Naami, Usman Malabu, Charles Agyemang, Francis Sambah, Theophilus I Emeto
pmc-13583762.description: are agendas. Non-communicable diseases (NCDs) are an increasing priority for African health systems, yet disability remains under-recognised in many prevention, screening, treatment, rehabilitation, and long-term care agendas. This article argues that disability inclusion is a missing pillar of Africa’s NCD response and should be treated as central to mainstream health-system design, not as a separate welfare or specialist concern.

pmc-13584330.title: Dose‐Escalated Upadacitinib for Refractory Myositis in Anti‐Jo‐1‐Positive Antisynthetase Syndrome: A Case Report
pmc-13584330.creator: Yuji Kukida, Hironori Inoue, Sharika Menon
pmc-13584330.description: Anti‐Jo‐1‐positive antisynthetase syndrome (ASS) can follow a relapsing course during glucocorticoid tapering, and evidence for refractory myositis remains limited. We report a 33‐year‐old woman with anti‐Jo‐1‐positive ASS with a dermatomyositis phenotype and recurrent myositis despite multiple immunosuppressants, biologics, and Janus kinase (JAK) inhibitors.

pmc-13593521.title: Effects of slope on lower-limb bilateral asymmetry and dynamic stability during running
pmc-13593521.creator: Lu Zhang, Zhengxiong Zhu, Ming Li, Hongshen Wang
pmc-13593521.description: PurposeTo examine differences in lower-limb bilateral asymmetry and dynamic stability across running slopes at a fixed speed.MethodsA repeated-measures secondary analysis of a publicly available multi-slope running biomechanics dataset was performed. Nineteen healthy runners ran at 2.78 m·s⁻¹ on five slopes from −6° to +6°. Asymmetry in five peak loading variables was determined using the percentage difference method.
